scope: demonstrated validated flow persistence, promotion, replay, and repair safeguards

commands.assertions: A validated demonstrated flow persists, reopens after restart, replays at an exact revision, and rejects wrong device/context or weakened assertions.

assertions: Demonstration promotion requires a passed run with assertions.
Replay uses the immutable saved revision and repair cannot remove or weaken checks.
limitations: This receipt covers the Device Control owner library contract; cross-owner browser-plus-desktop orchestration remains open.
